question: In a certain code language, 'PRESUME' is written as 'EEMPRSU'. How will 'NOCTURNAL' be written in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/LlhcJX-rTW9F3GmsdQ1rOFm_W353B04aNzD32rBcd-mcX-cmyFKLc1XdfomfCVaKKnT3oEOqwr7yCLGMo-Qav2NJO7-mtG7-_qH_LLPD-MPtAgvCcsGoEWJImwvtZ0JD7Mavz1QZ3ZBvvuOABEg9CA] 

'PRESUME' is written as 'EEMPRSU'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0efd8623825c1382daa48771f2082512dc2ff48cee879c7139d849187be41996.png] 

Similarly, 

'NOCTURNAL' is written as 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0e3b87910670bacc6b647f381fa41d68b9b56701bde90f54fbcb0cc778d9af4.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"ACLNNORTU".**
